submission.justification: Absorber-F2 at 4mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 3.03% at 100 GeV, significantly better than the 4.5% requirement. This is the optimal configuration among all materials and thicknesses tested. Absorber-F1 was eliminated as it fails to meet the 4.5% requirement at any thickness (best was 5.078% at 5mm). Absorber-F3 meets requirements with 3.88% at 5mm but provides inferior resolution compared to F2. The 4mm thickness for F2 represents the optimal point balancing sampling frequency and shower containment.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is listed in candidate_specs.md as a dense alloy with short radiation length

requirements.requirement: The energy resolution for 100 GeV electrons must be 4.5% or better
requirements.evidence: Simulation shows Absorber-F2 at 4mm achieves 3.03% resolution, well below the 4.5% threshold

requirements.requirement: The residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h
requirements.evidence: Dose rate data not available from simulation tool. All three materials are listed as candidates, suggesting pre-screening for basic safety requirements. This constraint should be verified through dedicated activation studies or vendor specifications before final procurement
Recommended thickness of 4mm is within the 2-10mm range
